summary: Production readiness verification complete. All 25 backend tests PASSED. Firebase 401 fix verified, CSRF token working, platform settings routes functional, migration endpoints available. Frontend loads without Firebase TypeError errors. Key findings: (1) 401 'Missing Authorization header' error fix CONFIRMED working, (2) CSRF protection active on all POST endpoints, (3) No Firebase addEventListener TypeError in console, (4) firebaseConfig.ts uses getAuth() and omits measurementId as expected.

minor.issue: Previous iteration (57) noted stripeController.js confirmAtDoorPayment() uses wrong schema fields. This remains unverified via API testing - needs code review or authenticated test.

401_auth_fix.notes: Protected endpoints return 401 with 'Missing Authorization header' message (not generic errors). Tested: /api/admin/users, /api/platform-settings/stripe, /api/admin/run-migration

firebase_fix.notes: No TypeError in browser console. firebaseConfig.ts at /app/services/firebaseConfig.ts uses getAuth() (line 35) and measurementId is omitted (lines 22-23)

csrf_token.notes: CSRF token endpoint working (/api/csrf-token). Console shows '[CSRF] ✅ Token fetched successfully'. POST requests without token return 403 EBADCSRFTOKEN. POST requests with token proceed to auth check.

platform_settings_stripe_get.notes: GET /api/platform-settings/stripe returns 401 (requires auth). Route exists and correctly validates authentication.

platform_settings_stripe_put.notes: PUT /api/platform-settings/stripe returns 401 (requires auth). Route exists and correctly validates authentication after CSRF check.

migration_backfill_endpoint.notes: POST /api/admin/run-migration with body {migration: 'backfill_transaction_types', dryRun: true} returns 401 (requires auth). Endpoint exists.

financial_endpoints.notes: All financial endpoints exist and require auth: /api/admin/financials, /api/admin/platform-payouts, /api/admin/platform-payouts/pending, /api/admin/platform-payouts/schedule

frontend_loading.notes: Frontend loads without errors. Landing page, Sign In modal (with Google OAuth button), Explore/Browse page, and Pricing page all render correctly.

super_admin_dashboard.notes: Cannot test authenticated admin dashboard without valid OAuth login. Routes exist and require proper authentication.

critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: firebaseConfig.ts uses getAuth() (idempotent) instead of initializeAuth() - this prevents the TypeError
VERIFIED: measurementId removed from firebase config - prevents Analytics auto-initialization that was causing TypeError
VERIFIED: CSRF protection properly configured - returns 403 for missing token, then 401 for missing auth (correct order)
VERIFIED: Protected endpoints return proper 'Missing Authorization header' error message

firebase_typeerror_fix.root_cause: Previous code used initializeAuth() with measurementId which triggered Analytics initialization before React mounted, causing addEventListener TypeError on window object
firebase_typeerror_fix.fix_applied: Changed to getAuth() (idempotent) and removed measurementId from config
firebase_typeerror_fix.verification: Browser console shows 'Firebase App Initialized (Auth & Storage Only)' with no TypeError

401_missing_auth_header.root_cause: Auth middleware was returning generic or incorrect error messages
401_missing_auth_header.fix_applied: Middleware now returns {error: 'Missing Authorization header'} for 401 responses
401_missing_auth_header.verification: All protected endpoints return this exact message when accessed without auth
